items.difficulty_reason: This lemma prepares the relative map approximation by reducing the data to a finite type situation and producing a diagram in which a formal local map factors through a finite type modification, so that the later approximation can be applied to the modified data. The proof performs the reductions on the diagrams and constructs the modification from the formal data, controlling the completions involved so that the subsequent lemma applies verbatim. Constructing the reduction so that the hypothesis of the approximation lemma is met is the substance. Retained author proof at lines 11205-11283.
